QUOTE: "The asm path is chosen by `constant_time_impl.h:40-52`. It requires all of: `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` defined ... `__GNUC__` ... one of arm/thumb, aarch64, x86-64 or i386. Otherwise `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is undefined"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is set in the header from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler-defined macros (`__GNUC__` and architecture checks), and is undefined otherwise. It never calls it an mbedtls_config.h option.
